name: Savage Skald
summary: A fierce tribal war-singer who turns critical blows, rage, and heroic summons into battle performances.

features.name: Inspiring Blow
features.summary: Begin this performance after confirming a critical hit to gain Charisma-based temporary hit points and grant nearby allies +1 on their next attack.

features.name: Incite Rage
features.summary: Induce a rage in another creature; a willing creature with the rage feature can rage without spending its own rounds.

features.name: Song of the Fallen: Silver Horn
features.summary: After ten continuous rounds, summon warriors as a horn of Valhalla for as long as the performance continues.
features.scaling: silver; brass at 13th; bronze at 16th; iron at 19th

features.name: Berserkergang
features.summary: Suppress pain, stunning, and fear for chosen creatures and grant DR 5/—, or DR 10/— against nonlethal damage.
features.scaling: one creature plus one per 3 levels after 12th

features.name: Battle Song
features.summary: Affect every ally within 30 feet when using Incite Rage.
